speaker: Doctor
text: That is a very specific symptom pattern. To help me understand the extent of your condition, can you describe how long you have had these symptoms and whether they worsen at night or with heat exposure? Also, have you noticed any scaling, thickening, or discoloration on your skin?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT) due to chronic arsenic exposure from livestock and rice farming, presenting with cutaneous photosensitivity and neuropathy.
